project_info.theme: In-store lucky number prize board event
project_info.color_palette: Sky blue, bright yellow, white, beige, red, denim blue

main_subject.detail: A tall in-store event board listing numbered prizes for a lucky draw game, flanked by apparel displays and event props like instant noodles and folded garments.
main_subject.style: Photorealistic retail event poster, in-store activation documentation, clean merchandising-event hybrid

assets.name: numbered prize board
assets.usage: Preserve the exact title, numbering, and prize list structure from 1 to 12.

assets.name: event copy and bottom banner
assets.usage: Keep all visible Vietnamese wording exactly as shown.

prompt_instructions: Attach the original image because the numbered list and store context need high fidelity.
Keep all visible text exactly as shown, especially the full prize list.
Maintain this as an in-store event documentation visual, not a clean isolated graphic.

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square in-store event poster for a BADASS lucky number game. Place a tall blue-yellow standing board in the center titled 'BỐC SỐ TÌM QUÀ', listing numbered prizes from 1 to 12 including 'MÌ CAY SASIN', 'VOUCHER 5%', 'ÁO PHÔNG', 'ÁO POLO', 'VOUCHER 10%', 'TẤT', 'SỊP', 'SƠ MI', 'QUẦN ÂU', 'BÌNH NƯỚC', 'QUẦN SHORT', and 'VOUCHER 100K'. Surround it with a realistic retail display: folded garments and instant noodle packs on a stone counter to the left, hanging shirts behind, and a white top with jeans on the right. Add the BADASS wordmark at the upper right and a lower banner reading 'THỬ TÀI VẬN MAY NHẬN QUÀ BẤT NGỜ'. Technical style: photorealistic in-store event poster, soft indoor retail lighting, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry text, incorrect prize list, low resolution, messy store, distorted board, missing props, watermark, signature
